skills.name: Horai Branch (蓬莱玉枝/蓬莱の玉枝)
skills.description: Kaguya Hime wields a jewelled branch from Horai and summons spirit energy to strike a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK and has a 10% chance of removing 1 onibi from them.

skills.name: Fire Rat (火鼠裘/火鼠の裘)
skills.line: How I long to return to that forest ...
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
When Kaguya Hime receives damage, she has a 30% chance of gaining 1 onibi.
If the Dragon Jewel protective field is active, the effect also triggers when an ally receives damage. When receiving AOE attacks, multiple strikes will not trigger the effect multiple times. ; : ;Dragon Jewel (龙首之玉) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Increases all allies' DEF by 15%, RES by 10% and has a 67% chance of granting 1 onibi at the start of their turn.

skills.name: Dragon Jewel (龙首之玉/龍の頸の玉)
skills.description:
Kaguya Hime forms a protective field, lasts 2 turns. The field increases all allies' DEF by 15%, RES by 10% and has a 67% chance of granting 1 onibi at the start of their turn.
While the field is active and an ally doesn't have enough onibi to use a skill, all the remaining onibi can be used the it. Each time this effect is triggered, Kaguya Hime sacrifices 5% of her current HP for each onibi spent and her field's duration is decreased by 1 turn.
While the field is active, this skill costs 1 less onibi to use. ;Dragon Jewel (龙首之玉) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Increases all allies' DEF by 15%, RES by 10% and has a 67% chance of granting 1 onibi at the start of their turn.
